find:
// load still in flight must not build into the tree this teardown discards.
      selfTestGeneration += 1;
replace: // load still in flight must not build into the tree this teardown discards.
why: Issue #1013. `dispose` never runs the self-test's close, so it spends the generation itself; without it a load in flight at teardown is still current when it lands and builds the body into the detached tree the teardown discarded.
